projectContext: Sprint 32 focuses on god file refactoring with smaller, testable stories after Sprint 31 had 0% pass rate due to timeouts. Key refactoring targets identified: (1) src/matching/tiered_matcher.py at 1,343 lines - extract embedding search and LLM reranking into separate classes; (2) src/matching/llm_providers.py at 1,042 lines - split into provider-specific modules; (3) src/downloader/retry_queue.py at 674 lines - extract config and statistics tracking. Each story targets ONE specific extraction with clear line counts and test requirements. Caption_fetcher.py work deferred pending completion of src/caption/ integration.
